name: APPSC Group-II Services
department: Government of Andhra Pradesh (Revenue, Panchayat Raj, Commercial Tax, Secretariat, Treasuries, Excise and others)
summary: Large Andhra Pradesh recruitment for executive and non-executive posts: Deputy Tahsildar, Deputy MPDO, GST Officer, Sub-Registrar, Assistant Section Officer, Excise SI, Senior and Junior Accountants and more. An objective Screening test and an objective two-paper Mains; no interview.

status.note: Brief Notification 37/2026 (686 posts) issued on 13 October 2026. Applications 10 to 30 November 2026; detailed notification with age and Screening date due by 10 November 2026.

posts.name: Goods and Service Tax Officer (erstwhile ACTO)
Assistant Section Officer (GAD / Finance / Law)
posts.notes: 71 + 5 + 4 posts. Finance needs a Maths, Economics or Commerce degree; Law needs a law degree.

posts.name: Senior Accountant (Treasuries and Accounts)
posts.notes: 90 posts. Computer certificate or computer degree required.

relaxations.note: Based on service, as per notification.
Plus length of service, as per notification.

age.summary: Set in the detailed notification (due by 10 November 2026). For reference, Group-I 07/2026 used 18 to 44 on 1 July 2026 under G.O.Ms.No.187 and 188 of 14 Sep 2026.
age.referenceDate: Date of detailed notification is the crucial date

eligibility.domicile: Local cadre and zonal rules apply.

education.summary: Bachelor's degree for most posts. ASO (Finance): degree in Maths, Economics or Commerce. ASO (Law): law degree. Senior and Junior Accountant: degree plus a BTET computer certificate (Office Automation, PC Maintenance or Web Designing) or a computer degree.

eligibility.physical: Excise SI has physical requirements (see detailed notification).
eligibility.examVsPost: Some posts need specific degrees or computer certificates; check each post.
eligibility.reservation: Andhra Pradesh rules: SC 15% (sub-categorised into groups as per the 2025 orders, applied as stated in the notification), ST 6%, BC 29% (A 7%, B 10%, C 1%, D 7%, E 4%), EWS 10%. Horizontal reservation for women (33 1/3%), PwBD, ex-servicemen and sportspersons. Local, zonal and multi-zonal reservation under the AP Presidential Order and local cadre rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: Age limits confirmed only in the detailed notification; 44 is the Group-I 2026 limit, used here as an envelope.

papers.name: General Studies and Mental Ability (degree standard)
Paper I: Social history of AP (social and cultural movements); overview of the Indian Constitution
Paper II: Indian and AP economy; science and technology

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from the Main exam (300 marks). No interview.

sections.subject: General Studies and Mental Ability
topics: History, geography, polity, economy of India and AP

sections.subject: Paper I
topics: Social history of Andhra Pradesh: social and cultural movements
General overview of the Indian Constitution

rankAndAllocation.text: Merit-cum-preference across posts, with community, local and horizontal reservations.

salary.notes: Starting basic shown is Deputy Tahsildar (44,570-1,27,480). Executive posts like Deputy MPDO and GST Officer start at 45,830.

career.promotionNotes: Departmental tests conducted by APPSC are needed for many promotions.
career.departmentalExams: APPSC departmental tests (held twice a year).
career.macp: Automatic Advancement Scheme as per AP rules.

benefits.detail: HRA or quarters, EHS, leave and LTC as per AP rules.

workLife.postings: Mandals, municipalities and offices across AP by zone.
workLife.nature: Field (revenue, panchayat, tax) or desk (Secretariat, accounts).

difficulty.rationale: Fully objective, AP-focused syllabus; competition for about 700 posts is very high.

ratings.rationale: Good state posts but notified irregularly.

factors.note: Past cycles faced court cases over reservation rosters.
